channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Euro edges higher to near 1.1600 on US-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1590 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. A deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz spurred a rally in riskier assets such as the Euro (EUR) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: RBA set to push brake on rate hikes amid signs of slowing economic growth
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) is widely expected to leave the Official Cash Rate unchanged at 4.35% when it announces its monetary policy decision on Tuesday, marking a pause after three consecutive rate hikes delivered earlier this year.

item.title: Gold holds gains as US-Iran deal reduces Fed hike expectations
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) trades with mild gains during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal extends the rally after the United States (US) and Iran reached a comprehensive framework deal to end hostilities, easing inflation concerns.

item.title: Bank of Japan expected to raise interest rate to 1%, its highest since 1995
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) will announce its monetary policy decision on Tuesday, at around 3:00 GMT.

item.title: British Pound Sterling's peace rally round-trips ahead of the Fed
item.description: GBP/USD opened the new week with a sharp risk-on pop toward 1.3450 as a US-Iran ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz sent Crude Oil tumbling and lifted risk-sensitive currencies. The entire move then unwound, leaving the pair back near 1.3400, almost exactly where it started.

item.title: The Bank of Japan can't save the Japanese Yen
item.description: USD/JPY is grinding into the Bank of Japan's (BoJ) June meeting above the 160.00 handle, a whisker from multi-decade highs, while the central bank meant to defend the Yen prepares to raise rates to a three-decade high without lifting the currency at all.

item.title: Australian Dollar advances as Hormuz breakthrough sinks USD and Oil
item.description: The Australian Dollar registered gains of over 0.37% on Monday as the US and Iran agreed on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at ending the conflict and setting the stage for talks about Tehran’s nuclear program.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar lifts off daily lows, Trump says Iran deal is signed
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) lifted off 10-day lows to reach the 99.70 price zone even after Trump said it was “important that Oil is plummeting and stocks are rising.” However, caution remains as Trump also warned that there would be “no sanctions relief for Iran until they do what they are supposed t

item.title: Peace breaks out and the New Zealand Dollar pays for it
item.description: Monday played out as a textbook risk-on session, with global equities ripping higher and Crude Oil tumbling after Washington and Tehran unveiled a framework deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average futures buy the headline on an Iran deal, not the fine print
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) punched to a fresh all-time intraday high on Monday, climbing around 1% as Wall Street cheered a preliminary peace agreement between the US and Iran.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: US Dollar retreats as inverted head-and-shoulders remains intact
item.description: USD/CHF retreats by over 0.34% on Monday amid most G8 FX currencies appreciating against the US Dollar, as the Middle East conflict eases following the US and Iran agreeing to a peace deal. The pair trades at 0.7943, after reaching a high of 0.7968.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG reclaims 200-day SMA as double bottom forms
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) price registers gains of over 3% on Monday as the white metal reclaims the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) of $68.59 amid geopolitical news linked to the US-Iran conflict.

item.title: United States Dollar weakens on US-Iran peace deal but remains supported by hawkish Fed outlook
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades on the back foot against its major peers on Monday as traders trim safe-haven positions amid improving market sentiment after the United States and Iran agreed on a framework peace deal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Gold explodes as US-Iran breakthrough crushes Oil prices
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) rallies by more than 3% on Monday after the US and Iran reached a deal to end their conflict, easing inflationary pressures amid falling Oil prices. At the time of writing, the XAU/USD pair trades at $4,351, after bouncing off daily lows of $4,218.

item.title: Australian Dollar rebounds as softer US Dollar supports risk sentiment
item.description: The AUD/USD pair rebounds near the 0.7080 region on Monday amid improved risk sentiment following reports of a preliminary United States (US)-Iran peace agreement. At the time of writing, the Australian Dollar (AUD) rises 0.46% against the US Dollar (USD), hitting its highest level in a week.

item.title: "The deal’s all signed”: US President Trump trumpets agreement with Iran
item.description: United States (US) President Donald Trump said on Monday that the Iran deal had been signed, adding that the Strait of Hormuz had fully reopened and that Oil prices were falling while stocks were rising. The President made the statement shortly after arriving in Evian, France, for a G7 meeting.

item.title: Oil: Strait of Hormuz reopening eases stress – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage reports that the U.S.-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz has significantly reduced immediate energy supply risks. This geopolitical de-escalation has lowered energy market stress and helped calm inflation concerns.

item.title: Euro holds firm as traders assess US-Iran peace deal, Fed decision looms
item.description: EUR/USD holds firm on Monday as the US-Iran peace deal boosts risk appetite, reducing safe-haven demand for the US Dollar (USD). At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.1598 after hitting an intraday high of 1.1662.

item.title: WTI Oil slumps as US-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal unwinds geopolitical risk premium
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil is falling sharply on Monday and trades around $79.15 at the time of writing, down 4.53% on the day.

item.title: British Pound rises as US-Iran accord sends Oil plunging
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) advances by 0.31% on Monday as risk appetite improves following an agreement reached between the US and Iran, which is expected to be signed on Friday in Geneva, Switzerland.

item.title: Japanese Yen gains ground after downbeat US industrial output
item.description: The USD/JPY pair trades with a cautious tone as investors digest softer United States (US) industrial activity data while positioning for the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) interest rate decision due on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rises on US-Iran de-escalation ahead of Fed decision
item.description: NZD/USD trades around 0.5840 at the time of writing on Monday, up 0.17% on the day. The pair benefits from broad-based US Dollar (USD) weakness as markets welcome news of a framework agreement between the United States (US) and Iran aimed at ending the conflict between the two countries.

item.title: Gold climbs over 3% as US-Iran peace deal sends US Dollar, Oil prices lower
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) starts the week on a positive note, rising more than 3% after the United States (US) and Iran reached a framework agreement to end the war in the Middle East.

item.title: Global macro: Growth resilience and policy risks – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage emphasizes that, despite improved risk sentiment from geopolitical de-escalation, investors remain focused on central bank policy and global growth resilience.

item.title: Swiss Franc gains as US-Iran peace deal dents safe-haven demand for US Dollar
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday as the Greenback's safe-haven demand fades following the United States and Iran's peace agreement aimed at ending the war in the Middle East. At the time of writing, USD/CHF trades around 0.7923, down 0.60% on the day.

item.title: US VP Vance: We expect Strait of Hormuz to be open toll-free long term
item.description: In an interview with CNBC on Monday, United States (US) Vice President JD Vance said that they expect the Strait of Hormuz to be "open toll-free in the long term," per Reuters.

item.title: Silver rallies as US Dollar slips on US-Iran framework, Fed decision looms
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades around $70.70 at the time of writing on Monday, up 3.94% on the day. The white metal is extending its rebound and benefiting from a backdrop marked by a weaker US Dollar (USD) and expectations surrounding the upcoming Federal Reserve (Fed) meeting.

item.title: Iran's Baghaei: Sovereignty and territorial integrity of Lebanon part of agreement with US
item.description: Esmail Baghaei Hamaneh, the Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran, said on Monday that respecting sovereignty and territorial integrity of Lebanon is a part of the interim agreement with the United States (US).

item.title: Brent: Prices retreat toward $80 on supply optimism – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman highlights that Oil prices have fallen back toward USD80 per barrel as markets anticipate normalized flows through the Strait of Hormuz after the US-Iran agreement.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Risk flows and policy focus – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage notes that the Japanese Yen is in focus as FX markets react to geopolitical de-escalation and shifting risk sentiment. The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz has supported risk assets, but investors remain attentive to policy divergence involving JPY, KRW and USD.
